balling.reason: No balling risk from this geometry: the balling screen uses the Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W (eagar-tsai-aspect-balling-screen-v1), which was not supplied for this result.

gasPore.reason: Gas inventory, transport, and pore nucleation are not resolved.
